params.caption: – Ingliz tilingiz qalay, o'syaptimi? – Ha, I'm doing progress! Tanish suhbatmi? Fikr to'g'ri, lekin inglizlar bunday demaydi 🙂 progress so'zi do bilan emas, make bilan ishlatiladi: make progress, ya'ni “oldinga siljimoq, o'smoq, natija ko'rsatmoq”. Masalan, I'm making progress with my speaking, “speaking'im asta-sekin yaxshilanyapti”. Yoki She made great progress in just two months, “u ikki oyda zo'r natijaga erishdi”. Yana bir nozik joy bor: progress sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun “a progress” yoki “progresses” demaymiz. Oldiga sifat qo'yish mumkin: We're making slow but steady progress. Sohadan keyin odatda in (progress in English), aniq ishdan keyin with (progress with my essay) keladi.
